events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders' frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Bday Angle
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the iconic Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking with The Pretenders. What's your favourite track from her?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Bday Angle
angles.copy: Our Kid is 54! Happy birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your top Oasis anthem?

events.title: The iPod's 25th Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the very first iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: iPod Anniversary Angle
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? Twenty-five years ago, the first iPod dropped and changed everything. How many songs did you cram onto yours?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day
events.blurb: Today marks James Bond Day, celebrating the release of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: James Bond Day Angle
angles.copy: Shaken, not stirred! It's James Bond Day. Who's your favourite Bond and what's the ultimate theme song?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: We remember John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: John Lennon Bday Angle
angles.copy: Thinking of John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire. What's your favourite Lennon moment?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: John Cleese Bday Angle
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the one and only John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, a true comedy icon. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: We remember the legendary Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Death Angle
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen track?

events.title: The Beatles' Rubber Soul Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary Angle
angles.copy: Fifty-one years of 'Rubber Soul'! The Beatles' classic album changed the game. What's your go-to track from it?
